chapter: Cab Calloway's band, Hadacol and closing reflections
title: This Little Girl from Jacksonville and the Hadacol line
summary: Danny and Lu perform the song and explain that its Hadacol line referred to a patent medicine.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: How does that tune go, Danny? "I know a little girl from..." -- where did you say...?
[DANNY BARKER PLAYS AND THEY PERFORM THE SONG FOR A WHILE]
...she can drink a lot of applejack...
That was some kind of a cough medicine, wasn't it?
But around here, they had it, they'd go to the bar, and say, "Give me a drink of Hadicol(?)."

So the "hadicol"(?) in the song, that was (?). And you'd say, "She can do the ring-dang-do," and I was straight(?), you know... Everything, like they're doing now, was supposed to be a new thing, that was in that tune.
